## **Pricing and paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Pricing and paywall.**
      1 recent review(s) mention pricing and paywall.
      Review window: Jul 31, 2026 - Jul 31, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention price, subscriptions, or paywalls. This can signal pricing sensitivity in the niche.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Mohamad Ahmadzadeh_, Jul 31, 2026, 1/5: "Confusing, expensive, and financially dangerous for beginners I deposited €10 through SEPA for a simple test. The deposit arrived, but everything afterward was a nightmare. A basic purchase flow led me into opening a 9.7 EURC loan at 15% variable APR, with an opening fee and interest charged every four hours. The interface made the borrowed balance look like extra portfolio money. I only discovered later that I had 8.86x leverage and almost all my funds were locked as collateral."

## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs and stability.**
      6 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Jun 2, 2026 - Jul 30, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _DAN_, Jul 29, 2026, 1/5: "New update is modern but removed coin count which is a massive miss. App still fails to load 90% of the time and even after it may load its riddled with failed loads, says its trying to resolve connection issues (always). At this point unless they fire the developers I assume they will continue to lose customers to usable platforms. High fees and a platform that doesn't work doesnt make the small niche things they do worth it. Seems this app is being abandoned or forcing migration to Kraken Pro."
            2. _Clara Clark_, Jul 29, 2026, 1/5: "app is slow as hell and the qr scanner will get the withdrawal address wrong sometimes and that's on you according to the awful ai they use as support"
            3. _Leandro Santos_, Jul 7, 2026, 1/5: "really bad app, slow, it re starts solo and also super slow when purchasing any crypto, app lags and restarts all the time, please get new programmers for this app"
